thread:
anya: Quick decision needed for customer comms after API outage: short public blurb, RCA access policy, and redaction rules. Need to finalize by EOD Thu so CS can notify affected customers.

olivia: paste current short blurb pls.

anya: draft:
Status: Resolved
Summary: Between 02:10 and 03:45 UTC on 2026-03-18, certain API requests experienced elevated errors due to a capacity provisioning failure. We deployed a targeted configuration rollback and services returned to normal. Affected customers may request a detailed incident summary from support.

mike: keep public text high-level. don't publish raw RCAs. infra will prepare a redacted RCA on request. Owner: mike. Draft redaction by Fri EOD; legal sign-off Mon.

sam: CS process: when customers request the detailed summary, CS opens an infra-redaction ticket including incident ID and customer ID. I'll draft the CS request template by Thu.

nina: legal: public high-level summary ok. On-request RCAs must remove customer IDs, IPs, raw traces, keys, internal hostnames. If sensitive traces remain, require NDA. Include a short redaction notes section in the shared doc.

anya: note: this is the third scaling-related incident in 9 months. Add remediation epic for infra-runtime: deep RCA, runbook updates, e2e load tests. Owner: mike. Proposals due 2026-04-08.

olivia: action items I'll own statuspage copy and will publish after legal confirms approach.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-18-API-123 closed. Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/postmortems/2026-03-18-API-123

anya: thanks all — closing thread unless more comments.
